title: Will power is a systemic cause

statements.text: If workspace dynamics implement Bayesian model selection, cognitive cycles are isomorphic with thermodynamic work cycles, and ignition events that update beliefs are sources of cause-effect power the way controlled explosions drive an engine. When those beliefs entail intentions and the feeling of willing, will power is a systemic cause and source of force.

sources.quote: If these beliefs entail intentions for acting and the phenomenology of willing, then will power may be a systemic cause and source of force in every meaningful sense of the words
these events may be sources of cause–effect power in precisely the same ways that controlled explosions drive engines to generate work
will power is proportional to the strength with which an agent predict/imagine actions for desired states in the face of obstacles to goal attainment
